items.myth: Studying abroad is only for toppers
items.fact: There are options for every profile
items.detail: Universities are at different levels. The right shortlist matters most.

items.myth: It's too expensive for people like us
items.detail: Many students go with a funding plan. Make a budget first, then pick a country.
Every course has a minimum score. Prepare, take a mock test, move ahead.

youtube.title: Is studying abroad only for toppers? Myth vs Fact
youtube.description:
3 myths that stop many students from applying abroad, and the truth.

There are options for every profile. There are ways to fund it. And your English doesn't need to be perfect, you need the required score.

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com

EduAbroad: Run by Harvard-Cambridge Alumni. 100% private. You contact us, we never contact you first.
